metadata.description: Joey Farbstein's free skills: ask-joey plus three marketing audits for contractors (website, local SEO, Google Ads), and raise-the-bar and hatch for people who build with AI.

plugins.name: ask-joey
plugins.description: Ask Joey about your marketing. For contractors and home service owners: /ask-joey routes you to the right audit, then /website-audit, /local-seo-audit and /google-ads-audit let an AI drive your browser and hand back one page of findings each. Read-only.

plugins.name: raise-the-bar
plugins.description: The AI can't grade its own work. A fresh critic says SHIP or NOT YET and names the one thing to fix. Loops up to 3 rounds.

plugins.name: hatch
plugins.description: Turn a fuzzy problem, half-baked idea, or risky decision into a shipped, defended result. Frame, diverge, judge, red-team, build, ship-gate.
